note: Recorded requirements for module DOC (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: Certificates from DigiLocker
requirements.description: The system shall fetch the applicant's caste and income certificates from DigiLocker with the applicant's consent and attach them to the application as verified at source.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant grants DigiLocker consent and an income certificate exists, when fetched, then it is attached with issuer and date and marked verified at source.

requirements.title: Upload where not in DigiLocker
requirements.description: The system shall allow the applicant to upload a caste or income certificate as a PDF or JPEG of up to 2 MB only when it is not available in DigiLocker, in the format to be notified by the department (open issue RES-3).
acceptanceCriteria: Given a certificate not found in DigiLocker, when the applicant proceeds, then upload of a PDF or JPEG of up to 2 MB is enabled.
Given a file of 3 MB, when uploaded, then it is refused with the size limit stated.

requirements.title: Reuse of verified documents for renewal
requirements.description: The system shall reuse documents verified in the previous academic year for a renewal application and shall not ask the applicant to upload them again, unless the certificate has expired.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a renewal application with a caste certificate verified last year, when the application is opened, then the certificate is attached and no upload is requested.
